title: Gate verdict record (plugin output)
description: Deterministic gate decision over an SPE credential-view report. Identical input always yields byte-identical output (gate_digest is reproducible).

gate.description: RELEASE = audit passed; HOLD = audit passed with warnings; BLOCK = audit halted, fatal issues, or fail-closed on malformed input.

gate_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical form of the verdict record itself (excluding this field).
